hooks.command: COUNTER_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/happy_title_check_${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-shared}"; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); COUNT=$((COUNT + 1)); echo "$COUNT" > "$COUNTER_FILE"; if [ $((COUNT % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"SYSTEM REMINDER: %d messages into this conversation. Re-evaluate whether the current chat title is still accurate and specific. If it has drifted or is too generic, call mcp__happy__change_title now before responding to the user."}}' "$COUNT"; fi
